title: 第5254章 闭关第5253章 完成任务
lines: “霄剑尊，你已经独立完成了三件地级地阶任务，恭喜你，自今日起你就是我碎星盟的天级成员，能享有天级成员的诸多待遇。”
“多谢。”
江玄接过储物戒和令牌，脸上也是露出一抹淡淡的笑容。
在成为这天级成员之后，他就立刻去了藏宝楼。
“藏大人，我要把这毁灭兽王雕像兑换成尊主复灵丹，按照之前所说，这尊毁灭兽王雕像价值五亿尊主复灵丹对吧？”
江玄开口道。
藏大人点头。
“那好，这尊毁灭兽王雕像五亿尊主复灵丹，而我这枚储物戒里，有两亿八千万枚尊主复灵丹，还有许多修炼资源，应该也能值两千万尊主复灵丹左右。”
“加上我这两千万尊主复灵丹，那便是八亿尊主复灵丹。”
江玄拿出一枚储物戒道。
藏大人扫了那储物戒一眼，轻轻点头，“可以给算你八亿尊主复灵丹，你想要兑换什么？恒君秘典么？”
“没错，我要兑换《恒君秘典》第一册。”
江玄直接道。
“可以。”
藏大人挥手把毁灭兽王雕像以及那储物戒全部收走，随后便开口道：“你在这里稍微一会，用不了太久就会有人将《恒君秘典》第一册送到你手里。”
藏大人道。
“多谢藏大人。”
江玄内心一喜。
离开藏宝楼后，他便怀着激动的心情，在这分部静静地等候着。
没过几天，就有人把《恒君秘典》的第一册交到其手中。
一间昏暗的房间里，江玄独自一人盘坐在那儿，而其面前则是悬浮着一幅巨大的卷轴。
这副卷轴很大，其中蕴含的讯息也十分浩瀚。
恒君秘典，乃是苍莽界一个实力无比可怕的尊主中期强者，恒君所留下的。
这套秘典不仅留下了恒君对时空规则力量、剑道的诸多感悟，同时里面还包括他创造的那些虚空剑术。
当然，最为重要的是，恒君还对这时空规则力量、剑道进行了十分详细的剖析。
深吸了一口气，江玄仔细阅读起来，他首先看到的就是对时空规则力量的剖析。
时空规则力量深不可测，从这第一阶段的时空分身、第二阶段时空绞杀一步步往上……
“太详细，对时空规则的剖析实在太详细了。”
江玄眼中迸发着精芒。
他就只是看到那最底层的一小部分，是恒君将时空规则力量第一阶段也就是那时空分身剖析的那一部分，他便被其震撼到了。
content_en:
"Xiao Jianzun, you have independently completed three earth-level tasks. Congratulations. From today on, you are a heaven-level member of our Broken Star Alliance and can enjoy many benefits of a heaven-level member."
"Thank you."
Jiang Xuan took the storage ring and token with a faint smile on his face.
After becoming a heaven-level member, he immediately went to the treasure house.
"Master Zang, I want to exchange this statue of the Destruction Beast King for the Lord's Restoration Pill. According to what I said before, this statue of the Destruction Beast King is worth 500 million Lord's Restoration Pill, right?"
Jiang Xuan said.
"Yes."
Master Zang nodded.
"Well, this statue of the Destruction Beast King has 500 million Lord Restoration Pills, and in my storage ring, there are 280 million Lord Restoration Pills, as well as many cultivation resources, which should be worth about 20 million Lord Restoration Pills."
"Including my 20 million Lord Restoration Pills, that's 800 million Lord Restoration Pills."
Jiang Xuan took out a storage ring and said.
Mr. Zang glanced at the storage ring and nodded slightly, "Can I give you the 800 Million Lord Restoration Pill? What do you want to exchange for? The Secret Code of Hengjun?"
"That's right, I want to redeem the first volume of "Heng Jun's Secret Code"."
Jiang Xuan said directly.
"Okay."
Master Zang waved his hand to take away the statue of the Beast King of Destruction and the storage ring, and then said: "If you stay here for a while, it won't take long for someone to deliver the first volume of "The Secret Code of Hengjun" to you."
Zangda said.
"Thank you Master Zang."
Jiang Xuan was happy in his heart.
After leaving the treasure house, he waited quietly in this branch with excitement.
Within a few days, someone handed the first volume of "The Secret Code of Hengjun" into his hands.
………
In a dark room, Jiang Xuan sat there alone, with a huge scroll suspended in front of him.
This scroll is very large, and the information contained in it is also very vast.
Hengjun's secret code was left behind by Hengjun, a powerful middle-stage lord in Cangmang Realm who was extremely powerful.
This set of secret codes not only left behind Hengjun's many insights into the power of the rules of time and space and the way of swordsmanship, but it also included the void swordsmanship he created.
Of course, the most important thing is that Hengjun also conducted a very detailed analysis of the power of the rules of time and space and the way of swordsmanship.
Taking a deep breath, Jiang Xuan read it carefully. The first thing he saw was the analysis of the power of the rules of time and space.
The power of the rules of time and space is unfathomable. From the first stage of time and space clones to the second stage of time and space strangulation, step by step...
"It's too detailed. The analysis of the rules of space and time is too detailed."
Jiang Xuan's eyes sparkled with brilliance.
He only saw a small part of the bottom layer, which was the part where Hengjun analyzed the first stage of the power of time and space rules, that is, the time and space clone, and he was shocked by it.
